Remark
[isometries of projective spaces force $ abla R=0$]

Source: petersen:page-0171 ↗ def:pet-ch4-cpn-submersion-setup 1. ch4:4.7.3(1) Show $U(n+1)$ acts by isometries on $\mathbb {CP}^n$ (it acts by isometries on $S^{2n+1}(1)$ commuting with the quotient action). (2) Show that for each $p\in \mathbb {CP}^n$ there is an isometry $A_p\in \mathrm{Iso}_p$ with $DA_p|_p=-I$. (3) Use that isometries preserve $ abla $ and $R$ to conclude $ abla R=0$. (4) Repeat (1)--(3) for $\mathbb {HP}^n$ using the symplectic group $\mathrm{Sp}(n+1)$ of quaternionic matrices with $A^*A=I$.
